## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 12, 2026 - Nov 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _#tegab_, Oct 13, 2026, 1/5: "This app is really a trap, there’s no provision to cancel Subscription, I have been unable to cancel and it still attempting to debit my account when I do not want to use it abt longer. Booby trap"
            2. _13thanon_, Jul 12, 2026, 1/5: "my number one gripe with this app that makes me not use it and heavily dislike it, is the fact that you have to subscribe or pay 100$ to have repeating tasks. on top of that, alert types and also many other planning settings are locked under the subscription / lifetime payment. im deeply upset that this app has failed in so many specific ways that i really did not expect. but alas, all i can do is leave this review."
            3. _Private Anderson_, Nov 1, 2026, 2/5: "started trying the App today. useful, maybe even very useful and promising. Daily routines, as advertized, are not included in the free version, that’s too bad. However, I will not pay 20$ annually for each of my 30 or 50 most used apps. Nope! Dont become greedy. if you lower the price to 4.99 annually, the number of subscribers should be 10-fold… Maybe introduce an intermediate version with a pricing a lot more accessible. An app like OmniFocus is different, of course, however a lot more complex then this rather nice but simple app - again: dont get greedy! Oh, and an included Pomodoro timer should be very useful. Yes: you are welcome for this free consulting or mine!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 27, 2026 - Apr 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Hic!_, Apr 6, 2026, 1/5: "I spent nearly two hours wrestling with this trying to set up on iPhone and Mac. Hopeless. Extremely buggy. Help chat was robotic and useless and flipped from English to Spanish randomly."
            2. _solenelee_, Jan 27, 2026, 1/5: "Pure scam. I wonder how they are app from the year 2025. I have the paid version, it constantly bugs. When I check a task done, the display puts it back as a duplicate... I have reported the problem ten times, there is no customer service. I can't even ask for a refund!! Really don't buy it, stick with your paper to-do list, it's better."
            3. _jenniferagainn_, Apr 23, 2026, 3/5: "It’s very difficult to use on computer because it keeps crashing down. I have to force quit after 20 min every time"
